spans.text: AKAKITEANGA KI TE KATOATOA I TE AU TIKAANGA TANGATA

E no reira, te akakite atea nei te Uipaanga Maata o te taokotaianga o te au Basileia, e ko teia “Akakiteanga ki te Katoatoa i te au Tikaanga Tangata”, kia riro teia ei mea tau tikai kia umuumu ia no te iti tangata katoatoa e te au Basileia ravarai, kia tauta te tangata e te taokotaianga tatakitai i roto i te oraanga tangata kapipiti na roto i te apiianga e te kimianga i te kite kia akamaata atu i te akangateitei i teia au tikaanga e te au tu rangatira ma te akamaara tamou tikai i teia Akakiteanga, e kia akapapu ia, na roto i te au ravenga akameitaki atu, i roto i te au Basileia, e pera katoa i rotopu i te au Basileia, kia marama ia e kia ariki ia e kia akono tamou ia e te katoatoa, i rotopu i te au iti tangata tukeke o te au mema Basileia e pera katoa i roto i te au iti tangata tukeke o te au pa enua i raro ake i ta ratou akatereanga.

spans.text: I te mea oki e, ko te maramaanga e te arikianga i te tu turanga ngateitei tiratiratu tumu tikai, e te tikaanga aiteite e te mutukore o te tangata katoatoa o teianei ao, ko te tango ia o te oraanga tamanamanata kore ia, te oraanga tiratiratu e te ‘au, i roto i teianei ao,

spans.text: E i te mea oki e, ko te akangaropoinaanga e te akava’ava’aanga i te au tikaanga tangata, i tupu ei te au angaanga rikarika tikai tei akatupu i te riri otooto ki te akavangakau o te tangata tini ravarai, e ko te riro anga mai o tetai ao te ka rauka i te taangaanga i to ratou tikaanga i te tuatua e te irinakianga ma te tamanamanata kore, e te oraanga mataku kore e te ngere kore, tei akakite atea ia e ko te akakoroanga puapinga maata rava atu ia o te tangata ravarai,

spans.text: E, i te mea oki e, e mea puapinga rava atu kia paruru ia te tikaanga tangata e te mana o te ture kia kore tetai tangata kia akakeu ia ki tetai mataara ei ravenga openga kia akatupu i te orureau i te tamaki atu i te takinokino anga e te akatuika’a anga,

E, i te mea oki e, kua akamou te au iti tangata o te Taokotaianga o te au Basileia, na roto i ta ratou papa ture tumu i to ratou irinakianga ki roto i te au tikaanga tumu o te tangata tatakitai, e ki roto i te turanga ngateitei tiratiratu, e te puapinga o te tangata; e pera katoa te au tikaanga aiteite o te tane e te vaine, e kua akakoro katoa ia e ratou, kia tauturu ia te tereanga ki mua o te au peu oraanga e te au turanga meitaki atu o te tu rangatira maata atu,

E no reira, te akakite atea nei te Uipaanga Maata o te taokotaianga o te au Basileia, e ko teia “Akakiteanga ki te Katoatoa i te au Tikaanga Tangata”, kia riro teia ei mea tau tikai kia umuumu ia no te iti tangata katoatoa e te au Basileia ravarai, kia tauta te tangata e te taokotaianga tatakitai i roto i te oraanga tangata kapipiti na roto i te apiianga e te kimianga i te kite kia akamaata atu i te akangateitei i teia au tikaanga e te au tu rangatira ma te akamaara tamou tikai i teia Akakiteanga, e kia akapapu ia, na roto i te au ravenga akameitaki atu, i roto i te au Basileia, e pera katoa i rotopu i te au Basileia, kia marama ia e kia ariki ia e kia akono tamou ia e te katoatoa, i rotopu i te au iti tangata tukeke o te au mema Basileia e pera katoa i roto i te au iti tangata tukeke o te au pa enua i raro ake i ta ratou akatereanga.
Auraka tetai uatu tangata kia akatuikaa ia me kore ra kia akanoo ia ki roto i te oraanga tavini taukore; e kia arai ia te au tu akatuikaa anga e te au tu okooko anga tangata.
E tikaanga to tetai uatu tangata i mua i te ture kia ariki ia tona tu tangata i te au ngai ravarai.
E aiteite te katoatoa i mua i te ture, e, e tikaanga to ratou kia paruru aiteite ia e te ture ma te kore rava tetai pirianga papakitai.
Auraka tetai uatu tangata kia akaapa taukore ia i raro ake i te ture, kia tapeka ia me kore ra akata’a ia.

Auraka tetai uatu tangata kia akaapa ia no tetai aatianga ture no tetai uatu angaanga i rave ia, me kore ra kare i rave ia, tei kore i riro ei aatianga ture Basileia, me kore ra, ture i rotopu i te au Basileia, i te tuatau i rave ia’i.
Auraka katoa tetai akautunga teima’a atu kia tuku ia i tei oti i te akanoo ia i te tuatau i rave ia’i te aatianga ture.

spans.text: E,i te mea oki e, e mea puapinga rava atu kia akamatutu ia te tupuanga o te pirianga taeake i rotopu i te au Basileia,

folded.subject: akaapa taukore
folded.object: i raro ake i te ture

spans.text: Auraka tetai uatu tangata kia akaapa taukore ia i raro ake i te ture, kia tapeka ia me kore ra akata’a ia.

folded.id: akakite atea|ia|e ko te akakoroanga puapinga maata rava atu ia o te tangata ravarai
folded.subject: akakite atea
folded.object: e ko te akakoroanga puapinga maata rava atu ia o te tangata ravarai

spans.text: E i te mea oki e, ko te akangaropoinaanga e te akava’ava’aanga i te au tikaanga tangata, i tupu ei te au angaanga rikarika tikai tei akatupu i te riri otooto ki te akavangakau o te tangata tini ravarai, e ko te riro anga mai o tetai ao te ka rauka i te taangaanga i to ratou tikaanga i te tuatua e te irinakianga ma te tamanamanata kore, e te oraanga mataku kore e te ngere kore, tei akakite atea ia e ko te akakoroanga puapinga maata rava atu ia o te tangata ravarai,

folded.id: akakiteanga|ki|te katoatoa i te au tikaanga tangata
folded.subject: AKAKITEANGA
folded.object: TE KATOATOA I TE AU TIKAANGA TANGATA

spans.text: AKAKITEANGA KI TE KATOATOA I TE AU TIKAANGA TANGATA

E no reira, te akakite atea nei te Uipaanga Maata o te taokotaianga o te au Basileia, e ko teia “Akakiteanga ki te Katoatoa i te au Tikaanga Tangata”, kia riro teia ei mea tau tikai kia umuumu ia no te iti tangata katoatoa e te au Basileia ravarai, kia tauta te tangata e te taokotaianga tatakitai i roto i te oraanga tangata kapipiti na roto i te apiianga e te kimianga i te kite kia akamaata atu i te akangateitei i teia au tikaanga e te au tu rangatira ma te akamaara tamou tikai i teia Akakiteanga, e kia akapapu ia, na roto i te au ravenga akameitaki atu, i roto i te au Basileia, e pera katoa i rotopu i te au Basileia, kia marama ia e kia ariki ia e kia akono tamou ia e te katoatoa, i rotopu i te au iti tangata tukeke o te au mema Basileia e pera katoa i roto i te au iti tangata tukeke o te au pa enua i raro ake i ta ratou akatereanga.

folded.id: akakore taukore|ia|tona turanga tangata basileia e auraka katoa kia akakore ia tona tikaanga kia taui i tona turanga tangata basileia
folded.subject: akakore taukore
folded.object: tona turanga tangata Basileia e auraka katoa kia akakore ia tona tikaanga kia taui i tona turanga tangata Basileia

spans.text: Auraka rava tetai uatu tangata kia akakore taukore ia tona turanga tangata Basileia e auraka katoa kia akakore ia tona tikaanga kia taui i tona turanga tangata Basileia.

folded.id: akakoro katoa|ia|e ratou
folded.subject: akakoro katoa
folded.object: e ratou

spans.text: E, i te mea oki e, kua akamou te au iti tangata o te Taokotaianga o te au Basileia, na roto i ta ratou papa ture tumu i to ratou irinakianga ki roto i te au tikaanga tumu o te tangata tatakitai, e ki roto i te turanga ngateitei tiratiratu, e te puapinga o te tangata; e pera katoa te au tikaanga aiteite o te tane e te vaine, e kua akakoro katoa ia e ratou, kia tauturu ia te tereanga ki mua o te au peu oraanga e te au turanga meitaki atu o te tu rangatira maata atu,

folded.id: akatere|ia|mei vao mai
folded.subject: akatere
folded.object: mei vao mai

spans.text: E pera katoa, auraka tetai akatukeanga kia rave ia no runga i te tu akatereanga, mana, me kore turanga i rotopu i te Basileia o teianei ao, me kore tuanga no reira mai tetai tangata, noatu e na te reira Basileia e akaaere iaia uaorai, te akaaere tiaki anga a te au Basileia, akatere ia mei vao mai, me kore i raro ake i tetai akakotinga anga mana ke.

folded.id: anau rangatira|ia|te tangata katoatoa ma te aiteite i te au tikaanga e te tu ngateitei tiratiratu
folded.subject: anau rangatira
folded.object: te tangata katoatoa ma te aiteite i te au tikaanga e te tu ngateitei tiratiratu

spans.text: Kua anau rangatira ia te tangata katoatoa ma te aiteite i te au tikaanga e te tu ngateitei tiratiratu.

folded.id: basileia|anauanga|me kore te au peu oraanga
folded.subject: Basileia
folded.object: me kore te au peu oraanga

spans.text: E tikaanga to te tangata tatakitai ki te au tikaanga katoatoa e te oraanga tamanamanata kore ia tei akanoo ia ki roto i teia Akakiteanga, ma te kore rava tetai akonoanga papakitai, no te tu iti tangata, te pakiri tangata, tane e te vaine, te reo, akamorianga, manako akatereanga me kore tetai uaatu manako ke, Basileia anauanga me kore te au peu oraanga, apinga nui, tu anauanga me kore tetai turanga ke atu.

folded.subject: e
folded.object: roto i te turanga ngateitei tiratiratu

spans.text: E, i te mea oki e, kua akamou te au iti tangata o te Taokotaianga o te au Basileia, na roto i ta ratou papa ture tumu i to ratou irinakianga ki roto i te au tikaanga tumu o te tangata tatakitai, e ki roto i te turanga ngateitei tiratiratu, e te puapinga o te tangata; e pera katoa te au tikaanga aiteite o te tane e te vaine, e kua akakoro katoa ia e ratou, kia tauturu ia te tereanga ki mua o te au peu oraanga e te au turanga meitaki atu o te tu rangatira maata atu,

spans.text: E,i te mea oki e, e mea puapinga rava atu kia akamatutu ia te tupuanga o te pirianga taeake i rotopu i te au Basileia,

E no reira, te akakite atea nei te Uipaanga Maata o te taokotaianga o te au Basileia, e ko teia “Akakiteanga ki te Katoatoa i te au Tikaanga Tangata”, kia riro teia ei mea tau tikai kia umuumu ia no te iti tangata katoatoa e te au Basileia ravarai, kia tauta te tangata e te taokotaianga tatakitai i roto i te oraanga tangata kapipiti na roto i te apiianga e te kimianga i te kite kia akamaata atu i te akangateitei i teia au tikaanga e te au tu rangatira ma te akamaara tamou tikai i teia Akakiteanga, e kia akapapu ia, na roto i te au ravenga akameitaki atu, i roto i te au Basileia, e pera katoa i rotopu i te au Basileia, kia marama ia e kia ariki ia e kia akono tamou ia e te katoatoa, i rotopu i te au iti tangata tukeke o te au mema Basileia e pera katoa i roto i te au iti tangata tukeke o te au pa enua i raro ake i ta ratou akatereanga.

Auraka ra teia tikaanga kia taangaanga ia no tetai akaapaanga tei tupu tika mai no tetai akaapaanga aati ture i vao ake i te akatereanga kavamani me kore ra no tetai uatu angaanga tei patoi i te au akakoroanga e te au vaerua o te Taokotaianga o te au Basileia.

folded.subject: kia akautunga
folded.object: i te tu kinokino rava

spans.text: Auraka tetai uatu tangata kia tamamae kino ia, me kore ra, kia takinokino ia, me kore ra, kia akautunga ia i te tu kinokino rava, i te tu taukore i te tangata, me kore ra, i te tu taakama ia.

spans.text: E, i te mea oki e, e mea puapinga rava atu kia paruru ia te tikaanga tangata e te mana o te ture kia kore tetai tangata kia akakeu ia ki tetai mataara ei ravenga openga kia akatupu i te orureau i te tamaki atu i te takinokino anga e te akatuika’a anga,

E tikaanga to tetai uatu tangata i mua i te ture kia ariki ia tona tu tangata i te au ngai ravarai.
E aiteite te katoatoa i mua i te ture, e, e tikaanga to ratou kia paruru aiteite ia e te ture ma te kore rava tetai pirianga papakitai.
Auraka tetai uatu tangata kia akaapa taukore ia i raro ake i te ture, kia tapeka ia me kore ra akata’a ia.

Auraka katoa tetai akautunga teima’a atu kia tuku ia i tei oti i te akanoo ia i te tuatau i rave ia’i te aatianga ture.

spans.text: E tikaanga to tetai uatu tangata i te aaere e te noo tamanamanata kore ia i roto i te au kena o tetai uatu Basileia.
